notes: Pattern given through GOOGLE_SDK_NODE_LOGGING, set before the first logger is made. The default node backend writes with console.error, so console.error is replaced by a capture (util.format plus newline) in place of stderr. The 100 loggers are created at load and picked by the fixture's numeric id; logger.info is used. The library colours its output only when stderr is a terminal and has no option for it; the harness runs it with stderr piped.
